titulo: Europe Today: Metsola exclusively on Euronews as Carney addresses EU Parliament amid Trump's tariff threat
cuerpo: EU Parliament boss Roberta Metsola speaks exclusively to Euronews, a day after Ursula von der Leyen proposed making Canada the EU's first "associate member" — a plan Trump has threatened with "very serious tariffs." Canadian PM Mark Carney is set to address the EU Parliament today in Strasbourg.
